tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind panels. Warm paper in light, near-black graphite in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, charts, dialogs: every raised working surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: code, table headers, sidebar, chart gutters.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and nav-item hover fill on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rules, chart gridlines' frame. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the strategy equity line, on ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, axis labels, table headers, on ground, surface and surface-sunken (≥4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder only. Fails 4.5:1 by design; never for information.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (tooltips, the toast).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip and toast fill.

tokens.name: forge
tokens.usage: The brand ember. Primary action fill, logo spark, the one running job. Rare by design: one forge element per view.

tokens.name: on-forge
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forge fill.

tokens.name: forge-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind forge text: the selected nav item, a primary-hover wash.

tokens.name: forge-ink
tokens.usage: Forge as text: links and the selected nav label, on ground, surface and forge-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: partition-is
tokens.usage: In-sample data: the window parameters were fitted on. Neutral on purpose; in-sample numbers are the least trustworthy.

tokens.name: partition-is-soft
tokens.usage: In-sample band fill behind charts and the IS training bar in walk-forward lanes.

tokens.name: partition-oos
tokens.usage: Out-of-sample (walk-forward test) data: bands, fold bars, OOS tags. As text on surface and ground.

tokens.name: partition-oos-soft
tokens.usage: Out-of-sample band fill behind charts; testing badge fill.

tokens.name: partition-holdout
tokens.usage: The frozen holdout: hatch strokes, seal border, lock glyphs, holdout tags. As text on surface and holdout-soft.

tokens.name: partition-holdout-soft
tokens.usage: Holdout band and seal fill. Always paired with the hatch pattern, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-proposed
tokens.usage: Proposed hypothesis: registered, no data touched yet.

tokens.name: status-testing
tokens.usage: Testing: runs in progress on in-sample or walk-forward data.

tokens.name: status-confirmed
tokens.usage: Confirmed: survived walk-forward AND the one-look holdout. Text on surface and confirmed-soft.

tokens.name: status-confirmed-soft
tokens.usage: Confirmed badge and verdict-banner fill.

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: Rejected: a finished, documented result. Graphite, not red: rejection is knowledge, not an error.

tokens.name: status-rejected-soft
tokens.usage: Rejected badge and verdict-banner fill.

tokens.name: status-inconclusive
tokens.usage: Inconclusive: evidence too weak either way. Text on surface and inconclusive-soft.

tokens.name: status-inconclusive-soft
tokens.usage: Inconclusive badge and verdict-banner fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Integrity alarms only: look-ahead leak, holdout breach, failed gate, destructive action. As text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger callout fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Methodology warnings that do not block (few trades, short window). As text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning callout fill.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive P&L and returns: heatmap cells, positive bars. Blue, never green, so gain/loss survives red–green colour blindness.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative P&L and returns, drawdown line, cost deductions.

tokens.name: drawdown
tokens.usage: Area fill under the drawdown curve.

tokens.name: chart-benchmark
tokens.usage: Benchmark / buy-and-hold line: dashed, 1px, behind the strategy line.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Horizontal only, 1px.

tokens.name: regime-low
tokens.usage: Low-volatility regime (bottom tercile of realized vol). Swatches and regime strips.

tokens.name: regime-mid
tokens.usage: Mid-volatility regime (middle tercile).

tokens.name: regime-high
tokens.usage: High-volatility regime (top tercile). Darkest in light, lightest in dark: stress always has the most contrast.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs (the holdout-unseal ceremony).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Page titles on the registry and tear sheet. One per screen.

styles.name: text-h1
styles.usage: Hypothesis title in the workspace header.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Parameters were fitted on 2019–2022 and never revisited.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: Updated 2 hours ago by T. Stokłosa
styles.usage: Metadata, table cells in dense tables, captions.

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels above a block. Uppercase via CSS, written in sentence case.

styles.name: text-statement
styles.sample: Assets with positive 12-week returns keep outperforming over the next week, net of realistic costs.
styles.usage: The hypothesis statement and research-log conclusions: the scientific claim, set apart from the UI chrome.

styles.name: text-note
styles.sample: Momentum premium attributed to investor under-reaction (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen 2012).

styles.name: text-metric-xl
styles.usage: The headline metric in a Metric tile (Sharpe, CAGR). Tabular figures.

styles.name: text-metric
styles.usage: Every number in tables, legends and rails. Tabular figures, U+2212 minus.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between related metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap between metric tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of page to title on registry and tear sheet.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, heatmap cells, partition tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the holdout seal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Stage-rail nodes and toggles only.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels. Borders do the work; the shadow is a whisper.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and dialogs: anything floating above the page.
